shadow_v3_active: The live runtime remains on the accepted v3 rig until an explicit cutover.
Only src/rig/skeleton.ts may import the v3 humanoid definition in the reachable runtime graph.
v4 stays testable in shadow without becoming the default accidentally.
v4_active: No reachable runtime module may import src/rig/humanoid.ts.
src/rig/canonicalV4Original.ts must be reachable from the runtime entrypoint.
The v4 shadow compatibility suite must be green before switching this mode.

notes: This contract controls runtime rig coupling only; it does not approve the ORIGINAL v1 mesh.
Historical/reference v3 files may remain in the repository if they are not reachable from src/main.ts.
